entries.label_vi: Nghệ thuật → tư duy sáng tạo: sản phẩm gốc, không có đáp án duy nhất, thử nghiệm và cải tiến
entries.claim: The arts develop creative thinking by requiring pupils to produce original work.
entries.because: Designing, composing or painting has no single correct answer, so learners generate ideas, test them, accept criticism and improve.
entries.result: Flexible thinking and confidence in one's own ideas, which innovation depends on.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề nghệ thuật, sáng tạo, thiết kế, môn tự chọn.

entries.label_vi: Nghệ thuật → giải quyết vấn đề: cân nhắc nguyên liệu, kiên trì sau thất bại; nhà tuyển dụng cần ý tưởng mới
entries.because: Artists analyse materials, balance competing demands and persevere through failed attempts, habits needed in engineering, science and business.
entries.result: Employers value people who propose fresh approaches.
entries.rebuttal: Creativity is not exclusive to the arts, and lessons that copy models encourage no originality; the benefit depends on real freedom to experiment.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề nghệ thuật, STEM, đổi mới.

entries.label_vi: Nghệ thuật → bày tỏ cảm xúc, giảm căng thẳng, tự hào về sản phẩm; bắt buộc để không bỏ lỡ tài năng
entries.claim: Art contributes to emotional wellbeing and confidence.
entries.because: Creating something gives young people a healthy way to express feelings and relieve stress, and displaying work builds pride.
entries.result: If art were optional, pupils who believe they are not artistic would never try it and some talents would stay undiscovered.
entries.rebuttal: Art uses time and materials, but short sessions and inexpensive resources keep the cost modest.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề môn nghệ thuật bắt buộc / tự chọn, sức khoẻ tinh thần.

entries.label_vi: Học nghệ thuật → quan sát, tập trung, kiên nhẫn, trí nhớ và tư duy không gian lan sang môn khác
entries.claim: Arts subjects train skills that support academic study.
entries.because: Drawing, acting and music demand careful observation, sustained concentration and patient, repeated effort; research has associated them with stronger memory and spatial reasoning.
entries.result: Pupils approach hard mathematics and science problems with more determination.
entries.rebuttal: Evidence is not entirely clear: motivated pupils may choose the arts, and the arts cannot replace direct teaching of literacy and numeracy.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề nghệ thuật giúp học tập, âm nhạc, thể thao.

entries.label_vi: Nghệ thuật giữ học sinh gắn bó với trường: thành công ở thứ hữu hình → tự tin, đi học đều, ít bỏ học
entries.claim: The arts keep many pupils engaged with school.
entries.because: Students who find written exams discouraging thrive when they can perform, design or create something tangible.
entries.result: Confidence, attendance and effort in other lessons improve.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề nghệ thuật, thể thao, môn thực hành, giảm bỏ học.

entries.label_vi: Thể thao → sức khoẻ thể chất (béo phì, ít vận động), thói quen sống chủ động
entries.claim: Sport contributes to physical health, which is increasingly urgent.
entries.because: Many children spend hours sitting at screens and obesity is rising; regular sport builds fitness and habits that last for life.
entries.result: Long-term health problems and pressure on health services are reduced.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thể thao học đường, giáo dục thể chất, béo phì trẻ em.

entries.label_vi: Thi đấu → biết thắng và thua, nỗ lực, kiên trì, tự chủ; cải thiện nhờ luyện tập
entries.claim: Competition teaches pupils how to handle both success and failure.
entries.because: Playing to win encourages effort and perseverance, while losing teaches children to accept disappointment and try again; training shows that improvement comes from patient, repeated effort.
entries.result: Resilience that serves them in exams and careers.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thi đấu, thể thao đồng đội, thi cử cạnh tranh.

entries.label_vi: Thi đấu đồng đội → hợp tác, trách nhiệm chung, tự hào tập thể
entries.claim: Team competition fosters cooperation and a sense of belonging.
entries.because: Players listen to others, accept roles and take shared responsibility; supporting the school team builds pride.
entries.result: Community spirit and motivation to keep fit.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thể thao đồng đội, hoạt động ngoại khoá, nghệ thuật nhóm.

entries.label_vi: Giới hạn: thi đấu phải hoà nhập, không loại trẻ yếu; nhấn mạnh nỗ lực và fair play
entries.because: If only the strongest pupils play, weaker children lose confidence, and excessive pressure to win can cause conflict or injury.
entries.result: Offer teams at different levels, emphasise effort and fair play, and provide non-competitive activities.
entries.reuse_vi: Câu giới hạn cho đề thi đấu / cạnh tranh trong trường.

entries.label_vi: Thể dục → giảm căng thẳng, cải thiện tâm trạng và tập trung, kỹ năng xã hội, tự tin
entries.claim: PE supports mental wellbeing, social skills and concentration.
entries.because: Exercise relieves stress and improves mood, pupils who move regularly concentrate better later, and team games teach cooperation and fair play.
entries.result: Self-confidence grows, especially for pupils who struggle academically.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề giáo dục thể chất, wellbeing, tư vấn học đường.

entries.label_vi: Khám phá đam mê → động lực học nội tại, kiên trì, định hướng nghề nghiệp
entries.claim: Discovering a passion motivates pupils to learn.
entries.because: Students who love programming, music or biology study longer and persevere without being pushed, and passion guides choices about future study and careers.
entries.result: Young people who have explored their interests are more likely to find satisfying work.
entries.rebuttal: Exams cannot be abandoned: qualifications are needed and provide a fair standard, so aim for balance.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề mục đích của trường học, câu lạc bộ, thi cử vs sở thích.

entries.label_vi: Học ngoại ngữ sớm → phát âm tự nhiên, nhiều năm học hơn, đạt trình độ cao hơn
entries.claim: Young children absorb sounds and structures easily.
entries.because: Before adolescence they learn through listening, songs and games, developing accurate pronunciation and an instinctive feel for grammar; starting early also gives many more years of study.
entries.result: A higher level of proficiency by the time they leave school.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề ngoại ngữ ở tiểu học, song ngữ, giáo dục sớm.

entries.text: A group designing costumes for a school play, for example, must find solutions within a limited budget and time.
A pupil who has repeatedly redesigned a clay model until it stands securely, for example, practises exactly the persistence that engineers need.
A pupil who sees a painting displayed in the school corridor, for instance, may gain a confidence that spreads to other lessons.
A child who plays football three times a week, for example, is more likely to stay active as an adult.
entries.caution_vi: Ví dụ giả định, dùng 'more likely'.

entries.text: A team that loses a match, for example, may learn to analyse its mistakes and train more effectively before the next game.
A pupil who joins a robotics club and discovers a talent for engineering, for instance, may choose a university course that suits her.
A child who sings songs in French every week, for example, may pronounce the language more naturally than a teenager who begins at fourteen.
A child who learns to enjoy swimming or running at school, for example, is more likely to remain active as an adult.
